research_question: How far can the already observed astrology-to-social-expression route structure be stated reproducibly without collapsing a multi-layer symbolic system into either heterogeneous ANY rules or one over-specific branch?

external_stress_results.interpretation: The heterogeneous ANY25 aggregate did not reproduce; coherent authored families were not individually tested.
The development-scale effect did not reproduce; a smaller positive difference remains unresolved.
The Dusthana-required branch did not transport; the carrier-free core stayed weakly positive and unconfirmed.

granularity_finding.too_broad: Heterogeneous ANY aggregation loses route specificity.
granularity_finding.too_narrow: Exact all-condition branches can mistake person-level modifiers for route cores.
granularity_finding.minimum_defensible_route_unit: A finite meaning-coherent mechanism family with predeclared alternative relation and carrier branches.

strongest_current_conclusion: Fixed development evidence contains repeated, person-traceable astrology-to-social-function structures across five non-exclusive functions. Three external stress tests constrain three particular aggregations or branches but do not validate the remaining families and do not establish that astrology as a whole is either confirmed or absent.
